agent_explanation: High-speed (vx~38.9) collision with ultra-thin wall (w=0.1) in substepped integration produces energy gain. Incoming speed magnitude at step6 is ~38.9, outgoing at step7 is ~41.3 despite e=0.91 which should conserve or lose energy. Speed increases from ~38.9 to ~41.34, total energy rises from 814 to 911 J exceeding E0+10% tolerance. Likely cause: collision with thin box using positional correction and impulse calculation during substeps adds energy when body grazes edge, or restitution applied to already-corrected velocity.
